name: Slothing
shortDescription: Open-source, self-hostable job-search workspace: tailored resumes and cover letters from your own documents, tracking, interview prep.
description:
Slothing is an open-source (AGPL v3), privacy-first job-application command center. Upload your career documents once, then build tailored resumes and cover letters, track opportunities and prep for interviews, with AI doing the heavy lifting while your data stays under your control.

Highlights:
- Document Studio: a single resume + cover-letter workspace with templates, version history and a TipTap editor.
- Knowledge bank: AI extracts structured profile data from uploaded documents for reuse across applications.
- Paste a job description and get a tailored resume and cover letter. Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama or OpenRouter.
- Opportunity tracker for jobs and hackathons, a review queue, text and voice mock interviews, and a browser extension that autofills applications and captures job postings.
- Turborepo + pnpm monorepo: Next.js App Router, Drizzle on libSQL/Turso, NextAuth, Vitest and Playwright.

Self-host it for free, or use the hosted version at slothing.work, which runs the same code plus a small proprietary billing module (open core).
